item.title: Appointments to BIS global payments standard-setting body and Consultative Council for the Americas
item.description: Bank of Korea Governor Hyun Song Shin appointed Chair of the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) Committee on Payments and Market Infrastructures (CPMI) for a three-year term from 1 November.
